text:
Omar R: Heads up — I think I found a cassette-rotation bug in the eval harness. Some synthetic fixtures are being reused across runs even after rotation TTL expires.
Mira K: ugh, that was fast. repro steps?
Omar R: ran the quantization smoke on the new 7B-qlora job, looked at the runner logs across two shards, and the same cassette IDs show up for different holdout seeds.
Jin Park: can you paste the runner logs? maybe the TTL is misread as ms vs s again?
Omar R: paste:
```text
2025-11-06T18:02:12Z runner[shard-7]: cassette_id=abc123 ttl_sec=0 remaining=-1 // TTL zero => never rotate
2025-11-06T18:02:12Z runner[shard-3]: cassette_id=abc123 assigned_seed=1001
2025-11-06T18:04:03Z runner[shard-7]: cassette_id=abc123 assigned_seed=2001
```
Omar R: note ttl_sec=0 on the cassette metadata; config says default should be 86400s. suspect code path that writes cassette metadata is dropping TTL when rotation is forced.
Sarah L: hmm could be the new cassette writer shim we added for synthetic batching. That PR set default TTL only in constructor not in the on-disk manifest.
Mira K: which PR? link?
Omar R: https://git.internal/r/redwood/eval-harness/pull/2478 (draft) — had a last-minute refactor around manifest serialization.
Jin Park: eval-ci-bot just reported a burst of holdout leakage alerts earlier, timestamp matches your run.
eval-ci-bot: [automated] eval-runner: 5/32 holdout-cohorts failed leakage-check -> notify eng-ml
Mira K: ok, short plan: 1) add a unit test that serializes/deserializes manifest and asserts TTL preserved; 2) hotfix to ensure default applied on hydrate; 3) run quick smoke on affected shards.
Sarah L: I'll own the hotfix PR, can you post the minimal failing test so I can reproduce locally?
Omar R: test gist:
```py
def test_manifest_ttl_roundtrip(tmp_path):
    m = Manifest(cassette_id='x', ttl_sec=86400)
    p = tmp_path / 'm.json'
    m.save(p)
    m2 = Manifest.load(p)
    assert m2.ttl_sec == 86400
```
Omar R: failing because m2.ttl_sec == 0 currently in CI reproduction.
Jin Park: good simple test. also add an integration check in the CI job that flags ttl_sec==0 for non-debug fixtures.
Mira K: is there any risk this will trigger a bunch of flaky failures if we ship quickly? we should coordinate with release window.
Sarah L: we can patch manifest hydrate inside harness only (no user-facing change) and run a canary on nightly cluster first.
Omar R: created issue #5824, and will rerun the smoke after Sarah's patch. linking logs to the issue.
Mira K: thx. also check whether the cassette eviction job honors TTL units; I've seen ms/s confusion previously.
Sarah L: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/eval-harness/pull/2481 — patch ensures manifest.hydrate() sets ttl_sec = default if missing and adds test. tagging @jin for CI rule change.
Jin Park: will add a CI lint that fails if any committed fixture manifest has ttl_sec==0 and fixture_type != debug.
eval-ci-bot: [automated] PR 2481: CI passed for linux-unit but integration is queued.
Omar R: running quick local smoke now (shard-3 + shard-7). will post results in ~5m.
Omar R: smoke results: shard-3 now emits cassette_id=abc123 ttl_sec=86400, shard-7 gets different cassette for seed 2001. holdout leakage gone for this run.
Mira K: nice, can we backfill a small regression test to ensure we don't regress on quantized runner path?
Sarah L: yes, I'll add a matrix entry for q4 and q8 quantized runners, small sample size, run in nightly.
Jin Park: ok I'm going to merge the CI lint after green on integration. thanks for catching this early.
Mira K: great work team :tada:
